headlines.description: — LaMelo Ball hit seven first-half 3-pointers in his return from a right ankle injury, Charlotte had 18 in the opening 24 minutes to match the NBA and franchise records and the Hornets beat the Atlanta Hawks 133-126 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: LaMelo Ball hits 7 1st-half 3-pointers in return, Hornets beat Hawks 133-126

events.name: New York Knicks at Indiana Pacers

headlines.description: — Jalen Brunson made a go-ahead 3-pointer with 4.4 seconds left and scored 25 points, OG Anunoby stole the ensuing inbounds pass and the New York Knicks rallied for a 114-113 victory over the...
headlines.shortLinkText: Jalen Brunson's late 3-pointer, OG Anunoby's steal helps short-handed Knicks beat Pacers 114-113

headlines.description: — Norman Powell scored 24 points, Kel’el Ware had 22 points, 12 rebounds and four blocks, and the Miami Heat snapped a five-game losing streak with a 106-95 victory over the Brooklyn Nets on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Heat beat the Nets 106-95 to snap a 5-game losing streak

events.name: LA Clippers at Oklahoma City Thunder

headlines.description: — Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scored 32 points before resting in the fourth quarter, and the Oklahoma City Thunder bounced back from a rare loss to beat the Los Angeles Clippers 122-101 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gilgeous-Alexander scores 32 as Thunder bounce back from rare loss with 122-101 win over Clippers

events.name: Washington Wizards at San Antonio Spurs

headlines.description: — San Antonio rookie Dylan Harper had a season-high 24 points and the Spurs led for all but 22 seconds in defeating the Washington Wizards 119-94 on Thursday night to rebound from a disappointing loss in the NBA Cup final.
headlines.shortLinkText: Spurs rebound from NBA Cup loss to beat Wizards 119-94

headlines.description: — Brandon Ingram scored 29 points, Scottie Barnes added 24 and the Toronto Raptors beat the slumping Milwaukee Bucks 111-105 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ingram and Barnes lead the way as Raptors beat slumping Bucks 111-105

events.name: Houston Rockets at New Orleans Pelicans

headlines.description: — Saddiq Bey scored 21 of his season-high 29 points after halftime, and the New Orleans Pelicans overcame a 25-point, third-quarter deficit to beat the Houston Rockets 133-128 in overtime on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bey has season-high 29 points to lead Pelicans' 25-point comeback in a 133-128 OT win over Houston

headlines.description: — Cooper Flagg had 23 points and 10 rebounds, Anthony Davis added 15 points and the Dallas Mavericks recovered to beat the Detroit Pistons 116-114 in overtime Thursday night after blowing an 18-point third-quarter lead.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cooper Flagg and Anthony Davis lead Mavericks past Pistons, 116-114 in overtime

headlines.description: — Nikola Jokic had 23 points, 13 assists and 11 rebounds to become the career assists leader among centers, and the streaking Denver Nuggets beat the Orlando Magic 126-115 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jokic sets the career record for assists by a center as the Nuggets beat the Magic 126-115

events.name: Golden State Warriors at Phoenix Suns

headlines.description: — Jordan Goodwin made the go-ahead free throw with 0.4 seconds left, Devin Booker scored 23 of his 25 points in the second half and the Phoenix Suns escaped with a 99-98 victory over the Golden State Warriors on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Goodwin hits free throw with 0.4 seconds left, Suns escape with 99-98 win over Warriors

events.name: Los Angeles Lakers at Utah Jazz

headlines.description: — Luka Doncic had 45 points, 14 assists and 11 rebounds in his fifth triple-double of the season, and the Los Angeles Lakers used a big fourth quarter to top the Utah Jazz 143-135 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Doncic has 45 points and a triple-double as the Lakers come back to beat the Jazz 143-135

events.name: Sacramento Kings at Portland Trail Blazers

headlines.description: — Deni Avdija made two free throws with 1.5 seconds left in overtime for the last of his 35 points, and the Portland Trail Blazers outlasted the Sacramento Kings 134-133 on Thursday night to open a home-and-home set.
headlines.shortLinkText: Trail Blazers outlast Kings 134-133 in overtime on Avdija's late free throws
